lines.t: Verse 1:
Sunshine on my face, breeze in my hair,
God’s grace hittin’ different in the open air.
Ain’t chasin’ the world, I been learnin’ to breathe,
Got joy overflowin’ like waves in the sea.
Don’t need the spotlight, I’m good where I stand,
Got peace in my heart and a plan in His hand.
Every little moment, yeah, I see His proof,
Turned my pain into praise, now I’m livin’ the truth.
Chorus:
Keep it movin’, keep it groovin’,
God’s been good, I ain’t losin’.
Even in the storm, I keep choosin’
Faith over fear, yeah, that’s the movement.
Keep it movin’, heart wide open,
Every word He speaks, I’m hopin’.
Grace too real, no need to prove it —
Just breathe it in and keep it movin’.
Verse 2:
I don’t stress, I just rest in the plan,
Don’t gotta know tomorrow when I trust the Great I Am.
Used to fight my battles on my own two feet,
Now I walk in love, that’s victory on repeat.
Life hits hard, but I rise again,
‘Cause He took my sin and called me friend.
Now I dance through the doubt, through the heavy and the loud,
I’m free, redeemed, and proud.
Chorus:
Keep it movin’, keep it groovin’,
God’s been good, I ain’t losin’.
Even in the storm, I keep choosin’
Faith over fear, yeah, that’s the movement.
Keep it movin’, heart wide open,
Every word He speaks, I’m hopin’.
Grace too real, no need to prove it —
Just breathe it in and keep it movin’.
Hands up, I surrender,
All love, no pretender.
Even when I don’t see the end,
I know He’s faithful again and again.
Final Chorus:
Keep it movin’, keep it groovin’,
God’s been good, I ain’t losin’.
Even in the storm, I keep choosin’
Faith over fear, yeah, that’s the movement.
Keep it movin’, heart wide open,
Every word He speaks, I’m hopin’.
Grace too real, no need to prove it —
Just breathe it in and keep it movin’.
Just breathe it in and keep it movin’.
